violation_type.title: Primary Caregiver's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Have Access to All Records (26 TAC §747.203(3))
violation_type.short_title: Primary Caregiver's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Have Access to All Records
violation_type.typical_finding: The substitute caregiver who was in charge during the primary caregiver's absence did not have phone numbers for some of the parents of the children in care.

finding_variants.text: The substitute caregiver who was in charge during the primary caregiver's absence did not have phone numbers for some of the parents of the children in care.

While the primary caregiver was abroad, the substitute caregiver who was present during the inspection encountered difficulty in accessing her own file, which contained important documents such as her Orientation, CPR/First-Aid Training, and Affidavit for Applicants for Employment. Unfortunately, the substitute caregiver's file was not available for review at the time of the inspection.
During the unannounced inspection, it was determined that the Primary Caregiver is out of the country.  The substitute caregiver did not have access to all required records for the children in care.
